description: 23 steps of shears used by a player in survival and creative mode: tripwire, leaves, a cobweb, wool, a vine, grass and dirt broken at the client's shears speeds with their drops and each break's wear, pumpkins carved from a side and from above (facing the player), a full beehive emptied of honeycomb and one at level 3 left alone; Circuit and both official servers give identical blocks, held stacks and dropped items
